company.name: EMOTION DRIVE WATERCRAFT JETCAR
company.shortDescription: Emotion Drive creates next-generation JetCars and watercraft. Currently raising funds to expand production and scale international sales.
company.description:
Emotion Drive is a next-generation manufacturer of innovative watercraft, based in the UAE. We specialize in the design and production of unique JetCars — vehicles that drive on water and are tailored for the tourism and leisure industry. In just 1.5 years, the company has generated over $2 million in revenue and established itself as a market leader in the region.

We are actively expanding across multiple verticals: launching leasing programs, partnering with hotels and resorts, building international distribution channels, and scaling the brand through influencer marketing and B2B collaborations.

In addition to our core models, the Emotion Drive team continuously develops new projects — from prototypes to full-scale production of premium watercraft. We design and test luxury water vehicle concepts that push the boundaries of marine innovation.

With in-house manufacturing capabilities, a skilled technical team, and a clear growth strategy, we are ready to expand globally and offer customized, high-quality watercraft to resorts, marinas, tour operators, and private clients.
